differences.what: Product fills more of each frame in A (about 40% of frame height vs about 30% in B); in B the speaker reads small and lost in empty set, weak for a colour-switcher hero

B shows a visible wall-to-floor horizon and a grey falloff in the top-left of every frame, so the sweep reads as a room corner rather than a seamless cyc; A's set is a cleaner, near-seamless warm white
Coloured caustic spill on the floor is longer and more streaky in B (red, orange, blue frames), drawing the eye out of frame left; A's spill is shorter and sits under the product
A's floor and lower frame are close to clipping white, so the base contact shadow is faint and the product slightly floats; B keeps more tone in the floor and a firmer grounding shadow

Clear/white colourway: A's horn and cabinet edges dissolve into the white set with little edge definition; B holds a touch more grey edge contrast on the cabinet rails, though both lose the horn outline

Black colourway in both sets is a near-silhouette with internal detail crushed, and the white colourway's woofer surround reads as a glowing ring; consistent across both, not a differentiator but a shared ship-blocker for the set
